items.stem: According to the hierarchy of controls, which option is the MOST effective way to address a hazard?

options.text: Eliminating the hazard at its source
options.rationale: Correct: elimination is the most effective control because the hazard no longer exists.
PPE is the least effective control and the last resort.
Administrative signage ranks below engineering controls.
Procedures are administrative controls, less effective than elimination.

items.explanation: Correct: elimination is the most effective control because the hazard no longer exists.

items.stem: A noise survey shows exposure above the limit. Applying the hierarchy of controls, what should be considered BEFORE issuing hearing protection?

options.text: Engineering controls such as enclosing or dampening the noise source
options.rationale: Correct: engineering controls rank above PPE and should be considered first.

options.text: Immediately issuing earplugs and taking no other action
options.rationale: PPE alone skips higher controls in the hierarchy.

options.text: Ignoring the result because workers are used to the noise
options.rationale: Habituation does not reduce the exposure or the risk.

options.text: Reducing break times to limit complaints
options.rationale: This does not reduce noise exposure and harms workers.

items.explanation: Correct: engineering controls rank above PPE and should be considered first.

items.stem: Select TWO leading indicators of safety-program performance.

options.text: Percentage of hazard reports closed on time
options.rationale: Correct: this measures proactive activity before incidents occur.

options.text: Number of safety inspections completed as planned
options.rationale: Correct: completed inspections are a proactive, leading measure.
Injury counts are lagging indicators, measured after harm.
This is a lagging outcome measure.
Costs paid reflect past incidents, a lagging indicator.

items.explanation: Correct: this measures proactive activity before incidents occur. Correct: completed inspections are a proactive, leading measure.
